def t_shapes(grid, color=2):
    """The T-shapes (3-cell bar with a centered stem) of the given color: (bar_row, bar_col_start, 'up'|'down') per shape."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []

            if grid[i][j] == grid[i][j+1] == grid[i][j+2] == color:

                    out.append((i, j, 'down'))

                    out.append((i, j, 'up'))
    return out


def fill_corner_slots(n, value, slots=((0,0),(2,0),(0,2),(2,2)), shape=(3,6)):
    """A shape-shaped grid with the first n of the given corner slots set to value."""
    out = [[0]*shape[1] for _ in range(shape[0])]
    for r, c in slots[:n]:

    return out
